From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@bigenterprisecorp.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: RFP request: consolidated subprocessor list + fallback playbook

Hi Vivek,

Following up on the RFP -- procurement has asked for two items before the 11/27 deadline: a consolidated subprocessor/vendor inventory with locations and data-scope, and a short cloud-fallback/contingency playbook that describes how Redwood would respond if a primary cloud region or provider becomes unavailable. They need specifics, e.g., which subprocessors process customer content, whether any subcontractors are multi-tenant, and whether cross-region failover exists.

Can you send an initial snapshot and a single-page playbook by Monday EOD? If you want, we can take a 30-minute clarify call next week.

Thanks,
Alice Morgan
Senior Procurement Manager
BigEnterprise Corp
(Attachment: BigEnterprise_RFP_summary.pdf)

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask.

We can deliver both items. Attached is an initial subprocessor snapshot (v1) which enumerates primary subprocessors, region footprints, and whether they handle customer content or telemetry. I’ve also included a short note on our cross-region model and top-level mitigation patterns.

A few quick clarifying questions to ensure we give the exact level of detail you need:
- Do you need contractual subprocessor agreements (SAs) attached, or is a mapping with SSA/POC names sufficient for now?

If it helps, we can schedule a 30-minute call Tue/Wed to walk through specifics.

Best,

Hi Alice — following up with the deliverables we discussed. Attached are: 1) subprocessor_snapshot_v3.xlsx (finalized mapping with data scopes, hosting region, SOC2 status, and contract pointers) and 2) cloud-fallback-playbook_v1.pdf (one-page executive playbook + 2-page appendix). Key points:

- Primary cloud providers: AWS (us-east-1 primary, automatic failover to us-west-2 for dedicated pools), GCP (regional failover per customer-configured routing). We list which workloads run on each provider in the matrix.
- Cross-region replication: customer content stored in encrypted buckets with geo-replication for Dedicated customers. Hosted API customers have configurable region pinning; default is multi-region warm standby.
- Typical mitigation sequence (summary): detect -> re-route to warm-standby region -> failover to compatible model variant if GPU availability constrained -> notify customer + open incident channel -> escalate to on-call infra.
- Subprocessor items of note: three analytics vendors (multi-tenant) process telemetry only; two ML-ops partners have access to model packaging artifacts (contracted SA + scoped access). All subprocessors listed with SOC2/ISO attestation where available.

If you want a technical DR runbook (step-by-step Merlin playbooks and router commands), Karthik and I can provide a separate appendix within 48 hours. Otherwise this package should meet the procurement needs for the RFP.

Would you like a short call Monday to walk the packet? Proposed 30-min window 11/22 09:00-09:30 PST.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: subprocessor_snapshot_v3.xlsx; cloud-fallback-playbook_v1.pdf)
